Opens a separate, empty TFL profile with its own keys. It hides your real data from a quick look, but a forensic examination of the phone could still find that a second profile exists.
Destroys TFL\'s keys and data on this phone, then shows a fresh app. Your recovery phrase can still restore your identity later, but not what was stored on this phone.

Measuring Argon2id on this phone and sealing your keys with its secure hardware. This takes a few seconds.

The only way to restore your identity
There\'s no \"forgot password\". Anyone with these 24 words can become you, so keep them secret.
BIP39 wordlist · not a crypto-wallet phrase
Write the words in order and keep them somewhere safe. Don\'t photograph them or save them in notes or cloud storage.
I\'ve written it down, in order

Nothing is requested now. Each permission is asked for the first time a feature needs it, and TFL works without the ones you decline.
Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, to reach friends\' phones in range.
This version of Android requires it to find nearby phones. TFL doesn\'t read your position for this.
To tell you when a friend\'s message arrives.
So Android doesn\'t stop TFL passing messages on for friends.
To scan a friend\'s QR code when you meet in person.
No analytics, no ads, no crash reporting. TFL has no internet permission at all yet.
Choose how TFL reaches friends. Nearby works from the start; Tor, for friends out of range, is set up now and arrives in a later update.
Message friends in range over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, with no internet at all.
Reach friends over the internet through Tor, which hides who is talking to whom.

Replace the TFL icon with a calculator that really calculates. Type your secret code and press = to open TFL\'s lock screen.
Use a different code from your PIN: anyone watching you open the calculator sees what you type.
The codes didn\'t match. Start again.
That\'s your PIN. Choose a different code.
When you finish, TFL closes and its icon becomes Calculator. To come back, open the Calculator, type your code and press =. While the disguise is on, TFL locks as soon as you leave it.

resources.string: Too many attempts. Try again in %s.
TFL couldn\'t check the PIN. Try again.

A PIN can\'t be reset: the PIN is part of the key that protects TFL\'s data. Wiping deletes everything TFL keeps on this phone. You can then restore your identity with your recovery phrase, but not the data.

This phone\'s secure hardware no longer has the key that protects TFL\'s data (this can happen after some system updates or a device reset). The data can\'t be recovered. Wipe TFL and restore your identity from your recovery phrase.
